texts.zh:
过了一会儿，[This.ContactCountry.GetName]的热烈气氛逐渐平静下来。我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]渐渐能够理解这些信号，最终能够确定他们是[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]，并对他们古怪的行为作出解释。

事实证明，[This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural]是一个好战的物种，他们最看重他们所说的“战士精神”。正确的应对方式是做出类似的回应。然而，他们似乎足够宽宏大量，以至于接受了我们对此的无知，甚至开始认可我们面对威胁时的冷静。
texts.en:
After a while, the enthusiasm of displays by the [This.ContactCountry.GetName] vessel declined. Over time, our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] grew better at understanding their signals, eventually identifying them as the [This.ContactCountry.GetRealName] and presenting an interpretation of their odd behavior.

It turns out that the [This.ContactCountry.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are a warlike species who value above all else what they call the "warrior spirit". The correct response would have been to make a similar gesture back. However, it seems they are magnanimous enough to accept that we could not have known this, and have even come to value our level-headedness in the face of what seemed like a threat.

label.zh: 很好，把他们的影像接过来！
label.en: Very good. Bring them on screen!
